title: Sphinx outcrop was always visible from the Nile

tellings.quote: this thing. This is a huge limestone outcropping that they always had to have known was there.

plain: The idea is that the rock the Sphinx is carved from was a huge limestone outcrop that people near the Nile must always have known was there. A researcher named Luke Caverns says this to Michels, without a named source, as part of his argument that the Sphinx site is older or stranger than the usual account.
